## Summary

Every public consumer now decides "may this item be publicly represented — and if not, what
does the honest tombstone say" through **one** selector: `publication-eligibility/1`. The pure
rule lives in `policy.eligibility`; its SQL twin is the sqitch `publication_dispositions`
change (append-only `publication_disposition` registry + `sig.effective_disposition` + the
shared `entity_eligible_sql`/`claim_eligible_sql` fragments inlined into the API and export
queries so a consumer cannot forget to apply it).

The conjunction: **no current denying disposition** (latest `decided_at <=
clock_timestamp()`, `disposition_seq` tie-break — evaluated at *access* time, so a withhold
recorded in release R2 denies under an R1 rollback on every origin/cache/archive path)
∧ **entity eligibility** (`organization.status` not withdrawn/suppressed;
`publication_review_required` lifted only by a *recorded* `allow` — operator release is an
append-only authority-stamped row) ∧ unchanged **sensitivity** and **effective-rights** gates.
Denials carry `{reason_category, authority, policy_version}` — the privileged `rationale`/
`decided_by` never reach the public surface (column-grants).

- **`db/`** — `dispositions.py` (registry model, batch `effective_dispositions` on the
  public-safe column set, `eligible_entity_ids`/`eligible_claim_ids`, `record_disposition`
  INSERT-only); sqitch `publication_dispositions` (immutability trigger, REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE,
  `sig_materialize` INSERT only, `spine_watermark` facet so a recorded disposition invalidates
  every cached read).
- **`api/`** — the **`cached_canonical_name` label leak is closed** (D-P31.5-2): `_label_for`,
  `/v1/search`, `/v1/entity` (tombstone), `/v1/claim` (tombstone, value/evidence nulled),
  `claims_for`, persisted resolution/contradiction/task/edge/accountability readers
  re-filtered at read time, `/v1/evidence` artifact-deny. New `publication` tombstone field on
  `EntityResponse`/`ClaimResponse`.
- **`exports/`** — `ShapingClaim.publication_permitted` conjoined into `publishable`;
  `sharing_edges` (withheld partner → no edge), `subject_entities`, `source_stats`,
  `source_runs`, `entity_labels`, `corrections`, `claim_weights`, `research_tasks` gated;
  `fetch_materialized_graph` post-filters all persisted seams under CURRENT dispositions.
  Tiles/analytics/dossiers/compartments inherit through the shaped dataset.
- **D-P31.5-2 — option B recorded**: the flag is enforced, not declared moot — SIG-TRUST-006
  requires review flags be *consumed*. The HG-11-approved partners serve
  `pending_publication_review` tombstones until the operator records `allow` rows (the
  operator action is documented in ADR-124, not auto-approved by the migration).
